svg.text: CT6 Energy Monitor PCB v0.1: full circuit connection diagram
Every resistor, capacitor, diode, jumper and GPIO, with the same designators and values as the KiCad netlist / Gerbers in hardware/fab. ⏚ = GND. Wires that cross without a dot are NOT connected.
2 · Bias VB ≈ 1.50 V (MCP6002 U1 unit A)
U1 = one MCP6002 (SOIC-8): unit A pins 1-2-3 = bias buffer · unit B pins 5-6-7 = voltage amp (section 4)
JP shunt on 1-2 = mA CT (100A/50mA, burden IN, DEFAULT) · shunt on 2-3 = 1 V CT (30A/1V, burden OUT)
4 · Mains voltage sensing (on-board ZMPT101B) + U1 unit B
⚠ 230 V AREA: 6.5 mm clearance + slot under T1. Never touch when powered.
T1 primary 0.26 mA at 230 V → U1B transimpedance (R47 2k7) → ≈0.70 V RMS around VB → R48/C42 filter → GPIO9
plugs into sockets J3 (left header) + J4 (right header)
All other socket pins: no connect.
your DevKit and verify each pin before
Antenna end = pin 1 end → board top edge,
Parts: values (all from the KiCad BOM)
R111…R161: 22Ω 0.1% burden ×6 (24Ω also works: set HA Burden 24)
U1: MCP6002 SOIC-8 · D1: SS34 · D11…D16, D41: BAT54S ×7
F1: 500mA PTC 1206 · F2: 100mA T 250V TR5 · RV1: 275VAC 7mm MOV
J1, J5: 2P 5.08mm screw terminal · J2: USB-C 6P power-only
J3, J4: 1×22 female header · J6: 1×4 pin header
J11…J16: 3.5mm jack SJ1-3523N · JP11…JP16: 1×3 header + shunt
H1–H4: M3 holes (H1 in mains area → plastic screw)
Why 1.555: the 1k/1k8 divider passes ×0.643 of the CT signal.
Fine-tune per channel: Cal = 1.555 × (clamp-meter A ÷ reading A).
1V CT with shunt on mA → reads ~25 % of true (safe, obviously wrong)
mA CT with shunt on V → CT runs OPEN → 0/4095 clipping
→ unclamp immediately. Ship boards with shunts on 1-2 (mA).
Tested on the breadboard (same CT channel values)
30A CT: 0.33 A light+fan · 12.66 A water heater (clean sine)
100A CT + 24Ω: 4.6 A induction cooker, no clipping
Not yet tested: on-board ZMPT101B + MCP6002 voltage stage
1. Measure DevKit row spacing (22.86 mm) + every used pin
3. Screw terminals: wire entry towards board edge
4. 6.5 mm mains creepage + slot under T1 kept
5. First power-up WITHOUT mains and WITHOUT CTs:
+5V ≈ 4.7 V after D1 · +3V3A ≈ 3.3 V · VB ≈ 1.50 V
6. Then one CT at a time, small load first, Clipped = 0
7. Mains last: fuse fitted, enclosure closed
